title: Run Configuration Schema v6.2
description: Schema for configuring a v6.2 diagnostic run (Competing Hypotheses Protocol + Interaction Mode). Controls whether the pipeline asks the user questions or auto-executes based on prompt heuristics.

process_description.description: Free-text description of the industrial process

interaction_mode.description: Controls user interaction level: auto=no questions, auto-execute full pipeline; interactive=ask user when CRITICAL/HIGH unknowns exist (original behavior); minimal=only ask for CRITICAL unknowns, use heuristics for the rest

run_mode.description: Selects the diagnostic execution policy: fast for interactive runs with bounded optional analysis; full for benchmark or exhaustive runs. The orchestrator must record which conditional stages ran or were skipped.

hetero.description: Heterogeneous preprocessing (E-1H, industrial-hetero-preprocessor) provenance block. Written by the Step 0.5 chain only when the stage reports status ok and the joined table is non-empty; in every other case the block is absent and DATA_PATH stays 00_input/preprocessed_data.csv.

enabled.description: Heterogeneous stage policy: auto=run the stage, adopt the joined table only when heterogeneous sources exist; on=force adoption; off=skip the stage entirely

anchor_path.description: Path to the E-1 anchor table (00_input/preprocessed_data.csv) the HX feature columns were joined onto

anchor_sha256.description: sha256 of the anchor table at join time (provenance fingerprint)

max_judge_iterations.description: v6.2: Max Judge→Diagnostician repair iterations per judge session

max_reviewer_iterations.description: v6.2: Max Reviewer repair cycles (each cycle re-runs Diagnostician+Judge+Reporter+Reviewer)

global_max_iterations.description: v6.2: Global cap — total re-diagnosis iterations across ALL repair loops
